llm.summary: This RSS-to-Markdown skill mostly matches its stated purpose, but its activation scope is much broader than that purpose while also allowing command execution and local file writes.

dimensions.detail: Network access, Python execution, and installing the requests package are proportionate for a script-based RSS converter, but the declared read/exec/glob/grep tool set is broader than the documented workflow needs.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown documentation and examples only; no executable installer or hidden install script was present in the inspected artifact files.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The description and tags include broad, unrelated triggers such as document generation, design, machine learning, search, and retrieval, which do not fit a single RSS-to-Markdown converter and could cause unexpected invocation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses local output creation, including Markdown files and feed_info.json under configurable output directories; no background persistence, privilege escalation, credential use, or destructive behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core behavior is coherent: fetch RSS or Atom feeds, parse feed metadata and items, convert them to Markdown, and save output locally.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing if you want skills to activate only on narrow, explicit RSS conversion requests. Use it only with feed URLs and output paths you choose, and expect it to run Python, make network requests to RSS sources, install/use the requests library if needed, and write Markdown plus metadata files locally.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: Artifact text supports this concern: the trigger language is broader than RSS conversion and includes unrelated topics, while the skill also declares exec-capable tooling.
[SQP-2] expected: Local file creation is expected for the stated archive/conversion purpose and is disclosed in the overview, capability table, file-save section, and examples, so this is guidance rather than an independent escalation point.
